mentions.name: Cyberpunk graffiti-tagging MUD-style walking game
mentions.description: A location-based mobile game where players walk around in real life and graffiti tag things, like Pokemon Go but without looking at a map on screen. The interface is text-based with room names and descriptions, like an old-school MUD, that update as the player walks in different directions. Rooms are based partly on real-life locations, with known points of interest re-themed to fit a cyberpunk aesthetic. Built in React Native with a Go backend, using PMTiles for map data.
mentions.source_excerpt: Building a map and text-based mobile game where you walk around and graffiti tag things (like Pokemon Go, except you are not looking at a map on your screen).
